## Intended use
Exploratory isolated character concept for Falanaras's default Blood Knight appearance, testing a mist-veiled dark romantic painted style with subtle forward motion; project-library art only, not yet canonical.

## Scene and background
Falanaras advances one measured step out of dense mist in a ruined Thalassian arcade, caught between shadow and cool falling light. His moderately sized two-handed elven sword is carried diagonally behind and beside him in a low ready position, its controlled red-gold radiance cutting through the haze.

## Subjects
One adult male blood elf Blood Knight, Falanaras: pale ivory complexion; lean, strong, realistically proportioned adult swordsman; mature angular face with high cheekbones; moderately pointed ears; restrained glowing green eyes; white-blond high ponytail and two long straight face-framing locks. He wears a compact open Blood Knight faceguard, leaving his expression unobstructed.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Keep close to the original game turnaround's restrained construction: fitted charcoal and black armor with dark crimson trim, moderate pauldrons, black cloth tabard carrying a clear crimson phoenix, red gemstone clasp, practical gauntlets and greaves, long split rear panels. Minimal decoration and restrained wear. The open faceguard has a crimson brow plate, short pale central nasal/brow blade, short swept side fins, and a low broad peak no more than a small accent above the forehead. The sword is a practical medium two-handed curved Thalassian blade, asymmetrical but not oversized, blade length roughly shoulder-to-knee, visibly pale solid metal with a close sheath of thin crimson, orange, and red-gold Light.

## Action
Taking one slow controlled step forward, left foot entering the light while both hands carry the hilt low near the right side; the moderate blade trails on a diagonal behind the right leg but remains fully visible and safely above the floor.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Forward movement is quiet and balanced: torso erect, shoulders relaxed, hips turning subtly through the step, arms naturally counterbalancing the weapon. He looks directly ahead with contained resolve, fatigue, and moral weight. Ponytail and tabard drift slightly backward in the mist.

## Setting and environment
Ruined high-elven Gothic arcade reduced to shadow masses, worn columns, fragments of crimson ornament, and layered blue-gray fog. The environment should feel half-remembered and painted over, with architecture emerging and vanishing through haze.

## Style, medium, and palette
Dark romantic fantasy concept painting deliberately retaining an early-generation, partially resolved beauty: broad oil-like strokes over loose game-concept forms, velvety charcoal blacks, translucent cloudy washes, smoky bloom, dry-brush abrasion, and many lost edges. Fine detail is limited to identity landmarks: eyes, face, low faceguard, chest phoenix, gripping hands, and practical sword silhouette. Restrained stylization, believable adult anatomy, no oversized fantasy features. Palette of cold soot, blue-gray mist, muted crimson, pale hair and skin, restrained green eyes, and a thin red-gold weapon glow.

## Camera and framing
Full-body three-quarter-front walking view at eye level, all of the figure and entire moderate sword within frame. Slightly closer than a technical turnaround but still useful as a complete design study.

## Composition
Falanaras emerges from left-center shadow into a narrow cool shaft of light. His forward step and trailing moderate blade create a calm diagonal flow, while fog curls around the lower legs and behind the ponytail. The frame is atmospheric throughout, with no large blank field.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
Cool broken overhead light through mist, with pale hair catching the brightest value; the sword produces restrained red-gold backlight in nearby fog. Quietly ominous, elegiac, purposeful, and morally tense rather than heroic.

Must change: Use the specified walking pose with the blade trailing low and fully visible; replace screenshot proportions and finish with restrained anatomy and foggy paint.. Provider input image 3: Rear movement, ponytail, tabard, and equipment reference for Falanaras. Do not exaggerate: believable athletic anatomy; moderate shoulders, ears, hands, boots, and armor; compact low faceguard with no tall spike; moderate practical sword far smaller than the dark-romantic reference. One character, one sword, two arms, two hands, coherent walking mechanics. Keep the sword fully visible and not touching the ground. Keep the armor simple and close to the imported turnaround. Fog must support mood and depth but retain readable identity anchors. No rendered text, logo, caption, UI, border, signature, or watermark.

Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent.
